title: Sources: DeepSeek plans to build a 1 GW data center in Inner Mongolia and aims to bring at least part of its capacity online by the end of 2027 or early 2028 (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Sources: DeepSeek plans to build a 1 GW data center in Inner Mongolia and aims to bring at least part of its capacity online by the end of 2027 or early 2028 — China's DeepSeek is planning a massive artificial-intelligence data center in Inner Mongolia, according to people familiar with the matter …
